projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

worker_order: For initial indices0..5 in seed-major/head-minor order, sequentially rotate three arms by initial_index modulo3; fresh Python worker per arm, identical common warmed state/reference.
anchor: original warmup old-probe NLL; no reanchoring on suffix or recovery
controller_geometry: same frozen full-state theta/m/v A/E/C; actual nonlinear Adam deployment; original reference suffix only, no relinearization; E already containsdt
source_novelty_scope: global raw-story/title components disjoint from default768,V3all1104,PFTall512 registered cohorts only; unknown pretraining/semantic/unregistered exposure remains

source_feasibility_amendment.reason: pre-model source availability only; original failed plan preserved

primary.future: equal-weight June/July mean NLL of hinge minus legacy; average fixed seeds within each source component first
primary.retention: old_test NLL of hinge minus ORIGINAL warmed head; not merely minus a potentially degraded legacy comparator
primary.retention_clarification: explicit immutable-anchor definition before model outputs; relative-to-legacy old NLL is secondary

bootstrap.resampling: paired source components within each category; fixed category counts; common draw indices for all arms/seeds/heads

primary.retention_gate: one-sided97.5percentile upper bound <=0.02nats versus original warmed head
primary.multiplicity: two predeclared heads, Bonferroni alpha0.025 each; within each require both gates; no best-head reporting
primary.conditions: all18 conditions must complete and predictions seal before any new gold payload is opened; failed census blocks gold access, no complete-case subset
primary.inference_limit: conditional on three fixed fits and balanced historical source sample; bootstrap coverage approximate; not across task families or arbitrary seeds

arm: all successful/failed suffix or original policy solves
cost_accounting.total_cpu: owner process CPU plus disjoint reaped child CPU, reported separately from earlier encoding/acquisition; nested controller/phase times are subsets, never added again
cost_accounting.rss: fresh worker full-process high-water marks plus owner high-water; these are not independent simultaneous-memory or energy measurements
cost_accounting.hard_termination: failed with retained logs and exactoriginal checkpoint; actual later prefix unknown if no final record, never counted as zero effect or success
cost_accounting.net_benefit: not automatically certified by the objective or passing statistical gates; explicit full cost comparison remains required

preserve: all initial and final theta/m/v and counters
persistence.actual_same_process_and_cold_worker_rest: full state and serving-head equality checked and costs charged
persistence.interrupted_midtrajectory_recovery: unit-tested separately; not silently added as an empirical arm or net-cost claim
persistence.same_graph_multihost: future separately preregistered study only; no source/parameter/control choice changed here

claim_scope: bounded one-family historical classification study of an optional retention objective; no actual agent-task, split, learned-edge, general-intelligence or deployment benefit claim
